## Loading data
```{r}
purchases <- read.csv("~/Downloads/dataverse_files (1)/amazon-purchases.csv")
users     <- read.csv("~/Downloads/dataverse_files (1)/survey.csv")

head(purchases)
str(purchases)
head(users)
str(users)
```

## Removing unusable rows and checking for duplicates
```{r}
n_before <- nrow(purchases)
purchases <- purchases[!is.na(purchases$Order.Date) & !is.na(purchases$Survey.ResponseID) &
                       purchases$Purchase.Price.Per.Unit >= 0 & purchases$Quantity > 0,]
cat("Purchase rows removed:", n_before - nrow(purchases), "\n")

cat("Duplicate user rows:", sum(duplicated(users)), "\n")
```

## Merging data
```{r}
merged <- merge(purchases, users, by = "Survey.ResponseID", all.x = TRUE,
                suffixes = c("_purchase", "_user"))

head(merged)
str(merged)
```
